day_0_7.template: Confirm inoculant applied at planting. Mention the 486 kg/ha benefit. Ask about seed quantity.

day_8_14.template: Ask about row spacing. Ideal is 45-50cm for soy bean. Encourage if on track.

day_15_30.template: First weeding reminder. Weeds in first 30 days steal nutrients. Ask if they've weeded.

day_31_45.template: Ask farmer to check for pests on leaves. Describe common signs: holes, discolouration.

day_46_60.template: Top dressing fertilizer reminder if in loan package. Timing matters — now is the window.

day_61_75.template: Ask farmer to estimate their expected harvest in bags. This helps GNA plan storage for them.

day_76_90.template: Ask about any yellowing, wilting, or fungal signs. Remind about fungicide if received.

day_91_105.template: Guide on maturity signs: leaves yellowing and falling, pods turning brown. Do not harvest too early.

day_106_120.template: Remind about drying to 12% moisture before buyback. Wet grain is rejected. Confirm buyback date.

day_121_135.template: Confirm buyback date and location. Remind about grade A quality requirements for best price.
